text:
priya: Heads-up: seeing repeated DecryptFailed for customer-mounted keystore on prod-private in eu-west-1. KMS audit shows intermittent 403s but no key-rotation entries. Anyone else?

sam: Noted. Is this on Dedicated or Private?

priya: Private VPC deploy for AtlasHealth pilot, single region.

liam: Can you paste the relevant audit log snippet?

priya: ```json
{"time":"2026-03-21T14:02:11Z","principal":"svc-keystore-proxy","action":"Decrypt","status":"403","source_ip":"10.44.12.7","correlation_id":"-"}
{"time":"2026-03-21T14:02:31Z","principal":"svc-keystore-proxy","action":"Decrypt","status":"504","source_ip":"10.44.12.7","correlation_id":"req-78a3"}
```

eva: Those 403s could be RBAC tightening from yesterday. @ops-bot did infra push any rolebindings to priv-keystore?

ops-bot: infra-ci: rolebinding 'priv-keystore-admins' patched on 2026-03-21T13:58:04Z by infra-ci (change-id: cb9f1e)

sam: If RBAC was tightened we'd expect 403. But 504s show upstream connectivity problems. Could be NAT/gateway or egress policy.

priya: We recently tightened NetworkPolicy egress to whitelist KMS endpoints. Maybe KMS endpoint IP ranges changed.

eva: Check audit logs for source_ip and trace. Immediate mitigation: create temporary service account with explicit decrypt permission and route keystore calls through it.

liam: Also recommend rotating the affected key if any suspicion of leakage. But confirm first — any successful decrypts from unknown principals?

priya: Runbook for triage:
- liam: lead triage & key rotation plan
- sam: RBAC diff + rollback plan
- eva: audit log correlation + bug filing
- ops-bot: run egress connectivity tests from the pod

priya: Commands:
```
kubectl exec -it pod/keystore-proxy-1 -n priv-prod -- curl -v https://kms-eu.example.corp/health
kubectl logs -n priv-prod pod/keystore-proxy-1 | grep Decrypt
kubectl get rolebindings -n priv-prod | grep keystore
```

ops-bot: egress-test: from keystore-proxy-1 -> curl https://kms-eu.example.corp/health returned HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout after 30s

sam: 504 suggests NAT/GW or upstream KMS throttling. Check VPC NAT connections and conntrack table on nodes.

eva: Also check audit-collector: we've seen dropped events when event size > 256kb. Could explain missing correlation_id. Filing bug SEC-1421: 'audit-collector drops large events causing orphaned decrypt attempts'.

liam: I'll prepare a canary rotation: create new key version, update keystore-proxy to use it, and allow rotation_agent SA decrypt permissions in a scoped RoleBinding. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/keystore/PR-842 (draft)

priya: Short-term backup: flip keystore calls to secondary KMS endpoint via private link in us-east-1 to restore traffic. Needs config change in routing layer.

sam: I'll stage RBAC rollback patch in case rotation fails. :thumbsup:

priya: If we escalate to P1 we open #incidents and run the IR playbook. For now track here.

liam: Running rotation now (t+10m). I'll post status updates.

liam: rotation done — new key version active, decrypts passing, 200s observed. Monitoring shows error rate back to baseline.

priya: Awesome. Follow-ups:
- update network egress whitelist with official KMS IP ranges
- fix audit-collector to preserve correlation_id and not drop large events
- postmortem if root cause is infra change

eva: Bug filed SEC-1421, assign to infra-observability.

sam: I'll prepare RBAC rollback notes and keep the temp SA until next deploy.

priya: Thanks all. We'll decide on postmortem and next steps tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
